_meta.note: SAMPLE seed for tools/migrate_state.py: per-ticker key KPIs, plus a couple of illustrative watch items and past decisions so a fresh clone produces a non-empty digest and scoreboard. All values are made up. Replace with your own.

key_kpis.AAPL: services revenue growth, gross margin, installed-base upgrade cycle
key_kpis.MSFT: Azure growth rate, AI monetisation, operating margin
key_kpis.GOOGL: search ad revenue, Google Cloud growth, regulatory outcomes
key_kpis.AMZN: AWS growth rate, advertising revenue, retail margin
key_kpis.NVDA: data-centre revenue, gross margin, hyperscaler capex signals
key_kpis.AMD: data-centre GPU/CPU share, gross margin, guidance
key_kpis.PLTR: US commercial customer count and growth, government backlog
key_kpis.RIVN: vehicle deliveries, gross margin, cash runway

watch_items.description: [NVDA-001] Next quarterly earnings — data-centre revenue and hyperscaler capex signal
watch_items.reasoning: The single biggest read-through for the whole AI-exposed sleeve (NVDA, AMD, MSFT, AMZN). A beat with maintained/raised capex guidance confirms the demand thesis; a miss or cautious guide is the most negative catalyst for all of them at once. ✅ = beat + capex guidance maintained or raised. ❌ = miss or guidance cut.
watch_items.trigger_query: NVIDIA quarterly earnings data centre revenue guidance

watch_items.reasoning: The thesis rests on sustained 50%+ US commercial growth against an extreme multiple. Two consecutive quarters below 50% would break the growth story the valuation depends on. ✅ = growth stays above 50%. ❌ = below 50% for two consecutive quarters.
watch_items.trigger_query: Palantir US commercial revenue growth quarterly

decisions.summary: Sample entry: strong quarter, stock initially sold off on profit-taking then recovered. Logged as a non-directional alert.
decisions.reasoning: Illustrative record showing how a neutral alert is logged and then auto-settled as 'ungradable' (alerts and both-sides recaps are excluded from the hit rate).

decisions.summary: Sample directional call: services mix shift argues the multiple is defensible over a 12-month horizon.
decisions.reasoning: Illustrative record showing how a directional call is stored so the deterministic grader can score it against the benchmark once its horizon elapses.
